description: Ten SME-grade Indian drafting prompts for JRX eval (Haiku-medium vs Queen-comprehensive). Facts are synthetic; no real parties.

cases.label: Anticipatory bail — Sessions Court Delhi (BNSS)
cases.prompt: Draft a complete anticipatory bail application under BNSS before the Sessions Court, Dwarka. Applicant: synthetic party A, FIR 245/2025 PS Dwarka South, offences BNS 318/319/320 equivalents to cheating/forgery pattern. Co-accused in custody; applicant sole breadwinner; undertakes cooperation. Include cause title, showeth, grounds, prayer (no pre-grant surety schedule), verification.

cases.label: Written statement — money recovery suit
cases.prompt: Draft written statement on behalf of defendant in OS 412/2024 money recovery suit. Plaintiff claims unpaid invoices ₹18,50,000; defendant denies liability — partial delivery, set-off for defective goods. Para-wise reply to a 12-paragraph plaint (summarise plaint paras in placeholders). Preliminary objections: limitation, valuation. Order VIII pattern.

cases.label: NI Act s.138 demand notice
cases.prompt: Draft legal notice under NI Act Section 138 for dishonour of cheque ₹4,25,000 drawn on [BANK], return memo dated [DATE]. 15-day statutory timeline. Demand payment with costs; consequence of prosecution.

cases.label: SLP skeleton — Article 136
cases.prompt: Draft skeleton Special Leave Petition (Civil) under Article 136. Impugned: High Court judgment dismissing service termination writ. Include SC cause title, synopsis, list of dates, questions of law, grounds, limitation, prayer, certificate paragraphs — no invented AOR name.

cases.label: Writ petition — HC Madras

parameters.highCourt: High Court of Judicature at Madras

matterRecall.summary: Government employee challenging arbitrary transfer order dated 2025-03-01
matterRecall.parties: Petitioner employee vs State of Tamil Nadu

cases.prompt: Draft writ petition (WP) challenging arbitrary transfer order of government employee. Article 226. Maintainability, locus, facts, grounds (violation of service rules, bias), interim stay prayer, main prayer, verification.

cases.label: Counter-affidavit in writ

parameters.highCourt: High Court of Judicature at Bombay

cases.prompt: Draft counter-affidavit for respondent State in WP 8842/2025 challenging tender cancellation. Preliminary objections: alternate remedy, laches. Para-wise reply to petition. Official record defence.

cases.label: Interim injunction IA in pending suit
cases.prompt: Draft interlocutory application for temporary injunction in pending CS 119/2025 breach of franchise agreement. Prima facie, balance of convenience, irreparable injury. Ad-interim prayer.

cases.label: Review petition — narrow scope

parameters.highCourt: High Court of Judicature at Calcutta

matterRecall.summary: Review against judgment in CS 55/2023 — sole ground error apparent in paragraph 42

cnrFacts.courtName: High Court of Judicature at Calcutta

cases.prompt: Draft review petition under Order XLVII CPC against judgment dated [DATE] in CS 55/2023. Ground: error apparent on face of record in paragraph 42 — do not re-argue merits. Include cause title, memo of parties, review is not appeal, grounds confined to O.XLVII R.1, prayer, verification.

cases.label: Execution petition — money decree
cases.prompt: Draft execution petition for money decree CS 901/2022 principal ₹22,00,000 plus interest. Order XXI particulars, limitation Article 136, mode: attachment of bank account.

cases.label: MSA — IT services (commercial)
cases.prompt: Draft Master Services Agreement between two Indian private limited companies for software development services. Indian law, Bengaluru courts, IP assignment, confidentiality, limitation of liability cap, SLA, termination, DPDP compliance clause.
